text: Please bring the original with you when you come to ChinaFor the students who have never studied in China： 1） The Photocopy of Passport (the main page and the page with signature) 2）Translated and notarized copy of final degree or diploma and transcript 3） Police Certificate within one year 4） Language proficiency certificate 5） Other certificates or documents 6）Foreigner physical examination form: bearing the stamp of the hospital. Physical examination results are valid for 6 months （ Includes a hair test to prove that the student has no history of drug use） 7） Application Form For School 8） Family Information Form 9） Financial Income Statement 10） A Short Video of Self Introduction 11） Commitment without Drug Use History ( Must be submitted with handwritten signature) 12） Application fee payment certificate. Pay and upload the certificate in the application submission interface, and note the personal information format: name, nationality, passport number, amount 13） Photo（format: JPG format, color, 2-inch ID photo, white background , the head occupies 2/3 of the photo, no less than 320 * 240 pixels, aspect ratio is 4: 3, the size is 100-500KB.）
